summary: Jack in the Box Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Jack in the Box Funding, LLC, completed a privately placed securitization transaction issuing $500 million of Series 2026-1 7.624% Fixed Rate Senior Secured Notes, Class A-2, and established a $150 million revolving variable funding note facility. The notes are secured by franchise-related agreements, real estate, and intellectual property. This is a routine debt financing and collateral arrangement, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
